cardSummary: A $125M boat that dives: steer underwater, switch on a headlight and fish from the bow while 110 seconds of oxygen last.
summary: Submarine adds an optional boat to the Boat shop for $125M. Take it east of the dock, press V to dive and steer through open water with the arrow keys or WASD. A bow headlight lights the way, a depth readout and an oxygen meter (110 seconds, refilled at the surface) sit in the corner, and you can cast and reel from the bow. Version 0.1.0 is a first playable preview.
controls: V (gamepad Y / Triangle): dive or surface.
Arrow keys or WASD (D-pad or left stick): steer underwater.
Hold and release Space or the left mouse button (RB / R1): cast from the bow; hold to reel.
Q at the surface: vanilla swimming.
apis: JAMM ModKit boat shop registration, lifecycle hooks on the player and boat, GameMaker instance, collision and drawing APIs, and the vanilla catch flow.
assets: Hull and shop card are generated at build time from locally sourced Tech Boat parts plus original SVG details. The package ships no extracted game art.
saves: The game's own save stores ownership and the equipped boat. A new session starts at the surface.
compatibility: Targets the August 2023 legacy VM archive or a compatible merged archive. Tested solo with the JAMM Console and in a profile with Perf, HD Lite, Console, Smooth, Silo, Weather Pack and Endless Ocean.
how: When the submarine is equipped and below the sea line, a controller takes over movement from the boat, applies buoyancy and a hull depth limit of 4,800 units, and counts down oxygen. Running out of oxygen starts an emergency ascent.
The bow cast reuses the vanilla rod and lure, so bait, bites, catches, selling and Fishalog progress work as usual. Reel in before moving or surfacing.

diagram.title: Dive loop
diagram.description: The equipped submarine dives, steers and fishes while oxygen counts down, then surfaces to refill.
diagram.caption: Upgrades, hull pressure and a shared dive query are planned for later versions.

changelog: 0.1.0: First playable preview: dive, headlight, oxygen, depth readout and bow fishing.

faq.q: Where is the submarine in the shop?
faq.a: In the Boat shop for $125M. Scroll the shop if the card is on a later page.

faq.q: Why can't I dive at the dock?
faq.a: Dive in open water east of the dock and steer around rock before casting.
